content.title: How to Watch Rangers vs Phillies: Live Stream MLB Opening Day, TV Channel
content.text: The Philadelphia Phillies look for a fifth straight postseason appearance and open the 2026 campaign on Thursday by hosting the Texas Rangers at Citizens Bank Park.PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA - AUGUST 18: Bryce Harper #3 of the Philadelphia Phillies reacts after hitting a two-run home run in the bottom of the seve...How to Watch Rangers vs PhilliesDate: Thursday, March 26, 2026Time: 4:00 PM ETChannel: Rangers Sports Network, MLB.TVStream: Fubo (TRY FOR FREE)Philadelphia retained designated hitter Kyle Schwarber on a five-year, $150 million deal and also brought back catcher J.T. Realmuto for three years and $45 million as the Phillies mostly run back last year’s National League East champion squad. They did add Adolis Garcia to the outfield after the 2023 World Series hero was non-tendered by the Rangers and inked left-handed starters Cristopher Sanchez and Jesus Luzardo to long-term extensions. The club did lose lefty starter Ranger Suarez and outfielder Harrison Bader in free agency and released Nick Castellanos. Right-hander Zack Wheeler opens the season on the injured list after surgery to address thoracic outlet syndrome.The Rangers have a new manager in Skip Schumaker, the 2023 NL Manager of the Year with the Miami Marlins, after Bruce Bochy returned to retirement. Texas sent five prospects, including last year’s first-round pick Gavin Fien, to the Washington Nationals for left-hander MacKenzie Gore and picked up Brandon Nimmo from the New York Mets for second baseman Marcus Semien to replace Garcia in right field. Also non-tendered was catcher Jonah Heim, with Danny Jansen signed as a replacement. Utility man Josh Smith, meanwhile, takes over for Semien at second base.Sanchez, runner-up in the NL Cy Young voting, comes off a season in which he put up a 2.50 ERA and 1.064 WHIP with 212 strikeouts in 202 innings and gets the start on Thursday for the Phillies.
